title: Frontend Developer
description: Builds user-facing web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern frameworks like React.
growthOutlook: High growth — demand for interactive web experiences continues to rise.

title: Backend Developer
description: Designs and maintains server-side logic, databases, and APIs that power applications.
growthOutlook: Strong growth driven by cloud and API-first architectures.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Works across the entire stack — frontend, backend, and databases — to build complete applications.
growthOutlook: Very high demand — versatile developers are prized by startups and enterprises alike.

title: Data Analyst
description: Collects, cleans, and interprets data to help organizations make informed decisions.
growthOutlook: Growing steadily as organizations become more data-driven.

title: Data Scientist
description: Uses statistics, machine learning, and programming to extract insights and build predictive models.
growthOutlook: Very high growth — one of the fastest-growing tech roles globally.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds, trains, and deploys machine learning models into production systems.
growthOutlook: Explosive growth fueled by AI adoption across industries.

title: UI/UX Designer
description: Designs intuitive, accessible, and visually appealing digital experiences for users.
growthOutlook: Steady growth as companies invest in user experience.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automates infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and ensures reliable deployment of software systems.
growthOutlook: High growth — cloud-native operations are now essential.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protects systems and networks from threats by monitoring, detecting, and responding to security incidents.
growthOutlook: Very high demand amid rising cyber threats worldwide.

title: Product Manager
description: Defines product vision, gathers requirements, and coordinates between engineering, design, and business teams.
growthOutlook: Consistently strong demand across tech and non-tech companies.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Designs and manages scalable cloud infrastructure on platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
growthOutlook: High growth as more companies migrate to the cloud.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Builds native or cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.
growthOutlook: Steady growth driven by mobile-first business strategies.

title: Business Analyst
description: Bridges business needs and technical solutions through requirements gathering and process analysis.

title: QA / Test Engineer
description: Ensures software quality through manual and automated testing strategies.
growthOutlook: Steady demand as automation testing grows in importance.

title: AI Prompt Engineer
description: Designs and optimizes prompts and workflows for large language models and AI agents.
growthOutlook: Emerging but rapidly growing field tied to generative AI adoption.
